name: Battle Start Party
summary:
А collection of four vibrant and engaging mini-games suitable for all ages.

Archery Contest - Test your aim and become the best marksman! Shoot for the bull's eye, hit apples, and skillfully dodge arrows from your opponents.

Team Fishing - Become the best fisherman on the coast. Navigate the ocean waves to catch colorful sea creatures, but be sure to avoid the spiky sea urchins hiding in the water!
